item.title: KISS Icon Gene Simmons Speaks Out on Reagan Movie Controversy
item.description: Gene Simmons—yes, the man with the tongue, the fire-breathing antics, and more merchandise than a small country—has added movie soundtrack contributor to his résumé. Recently, he recorded a cover of “Stormy Weather” for the biopic Reagan.
